story_title: As Technical Support Staff, I want to record equipment as unavailable, damaged or under maintenance so that it is not considered available for event reservations

acceptance_criteria.text: Technical Support Staff can mark a piece of equipment as unavailable, damaged, or under maintenance.
Technical Support Staff can provide a reason for the unavailability.
Equipment marked unavailable is excluded from the availability checks used in Check Equipment Availability and Reserve Equipment.

Given marking equipment unavailable leaves an existing reservation for an upcoming event without sufficient quantity, when the status is recorded, then the reservation is flagged for review rather than cancelled, and the assigned Coordinator is notified.
Technical Support Staff can return equipment to an available status, after which it is counted in availability checks again.
Authorised users can view an equipment item's current operational status.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-11: Units, not the whole item - Technical Support record how many of an item's units are out of service (SPM-48's Equipment.quantityInMaintenance), so 2 of 10 projectors out leaves 8 counted.

RESOLVED 2026-10-11: AC1's three words are a 'Type' choice - Unavailable, Damaged or Under maintenance - stored with the count, one type per item at a time. Needs a small migration (a type column on equipment).
RESOLVED 2026-10-11: The reason is optional (AC2 'can provide'), as in SPM-48's API. When given, it is shown after the type and included in the Coordinator's notification (TC04).
RESOLVED 2026-10-11: No return date and no automatic pre-booking - customer #23 says neither is specified. Units stay out of service until Technical Support return them (AC5).
RESOLVED 2026-10-11: Only Technical Support record or return it (customer #9).

RESOLVED 2026-10-11: AC4 flags every Reserved or Partially fulfilled request of an event that has not ended whose dates are now short of what is reserved. When several events share the same days and the units left cannot cover them all, all of them are flagged - the system does not choose (TC08). A flag is the existing EquipmentRequest.needsReview / reviewReason (SPM-62's columns), with a new reason code; the request is not changed or cancelled. Clearing a flag is SPM-68.

RESOLVED 2026-10-11: AC4's notification goes to each flagged event's assigned Coordinator (notifyUser, as SPM-45). It cannot be seen on screen until SPM-71 builds Notifications, so the save result says 'coordinators notified' and lists what was flagged (TC06), as SPM-39 and SPM-45 do.

RESOLVED 2026-10-11: AC6 'authorised users' are internal staff with equipment:view - Coordinators and Technical Support (sidebar 'Equipment'), and the Operations Manager by address (no sidebar link: existing Known Gap, not changed here). The Organiser does not see operational status, even though they hold equipment:view to pick items on the request form (TC11).

RESOLVED 2026-10-11: Technical Support can lower the number (return some units) in the same dialog, or 'Return all to available'. Flags already raised stay until the Coordinator reviews them (SPM-68).

DECIDED 2026-10-11: The screen is the sidebar 'Equipment' page (/equipment, currently 'not built yet'). Columns: Equipment, Category, Total units, Out of service, Status, Reason. Status badges: 'Available', 'Partly out of service', 'Out of service'. Reason column: '<Type> - <reason>', or the type alone.

DECIDED 2026-10-11: Wording - button 'Record unavailability' opening a dialog 'Record unavailability - <item>' with 'Units out of service', 'Type' and 'Reason (optional)', and 'Save' / 'Cancel'; 'Return all to available' opening 'Return all units to available?' with 'Return to available'. Messages: 'Saved. <n> of <total> <item> units are out of service. No reservations were affected.'; amber panel 'Saved - <n> reservation(s) flagged for review, coordinators notified' listing '<event>: <reserved> reserved, <available> available'; 'All <item> units are back in service.'; too many: SPM-48's existing 'Only <total> units in total - cannot mark <n> as out of service'.

DECIDED 2026-10-11: Technical Support's equipment request screen says 'out of service' instead of 'in maintenance' in its availability line, since units may also be damaged or unavailable (TC02, TC03).

DECIDED 2026-10-11: Fixtures (scripts/seed-spm55.ts, npm run fixtures:spm55) - dedicated items so no other story's equipment changes: 'SPM55 Laser Projector' (4, none out), 'SPM55 Wireless Presenter' (6; Reserved 4 for 'SPM55 Harbour Product Launch' 10 Aug 2027 and 2 for 'SPM55 Quiet Board Meeting' 24 Aug 2027, 6 for completed 'SPM55 Past Roadshow' 1 Sep 2026), 'SPM55 Stage Monitor' (6; 3 each for 'SPM55 Morning Showcase' and 'SPM55 Evening Showcase', 17 Aug 2027), 'SPM55 Spare Microphone Kit' (5, 3 out 'Under maintenance - Cable fault'); events 'SPM55 Availability Check Forum' (9 Aug 2027) and 'SPM55 Return Check Seminar' (23 Aug 2027) each requesting 4 SPM55 Laser Projectors, not reserved. All events in Planning (except the completed one), coordinator Daniel Tan.

DECIDED 2026-10-11: AC6's 'authorised users' are the new permission equipment:view_status (Coordinator, Operations Manager, Technical Support). The organiser keeps equipment:view for the request form, but GET /api/equipment no longer sends them the out-of-service count, type or reason.
